editorial:
Imagine carrying a secret burden for twenty years that slowly eats away at your soul. You meet Damian, a guy in his 30s who is just trying to hold it together while fighting a drinking problem. He was hurt by priests when he was a kid, and that pain hasn't gone away; it has just turned into a cold, hard need for payback. The movie takes you through a dark night in the city as he visits gay bars and clubs, but he isn't looking for love. He is hunting for the people who ruined his life. The vibe is heavy and tense, making you feel the anger building up inside him as he prepares for something violent.

You will notice that the acting is very raw and makes the pain feel real. The pacing starts slow but picks up speed as Damian begins his bloody ritual of revenge. While the story is very sad and hard to watch at times, it handles the topic of justice in a way that makes you question if revenge ever actually heals anything. If you like dark stories about trauma, you should definitely check this out. You can rent it on Apple TV for a quick watch, but if you want the best picture quality, adding the 4K Blu-ray to your physical collection is the way to go.
endingExplained: The movie ends with Damian completing his violent plan to kill the men who abused him. He carries out a bloody ritual that he believes will clean his soul and give him peace. After the violence is over, the movie asks if this was actually justice or just more pain. He finally lets go of his anger, but the ending leaves you wondering if he can ever truly move on from his past.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves gritty dramas about overcoming trauma and seeking revenge.
